### 📈 Dimensional Scaling Theorems & Percentage Multipliers

1. **Linear Scaling Invariant:** If all linear dimensions of any 2D or 3D geometric figure are multiplied by scale factor (k):
   • All Linear parameters (Perimeter, Circumference, Diagonal, Height, Radius) scale by (k^1).
   • All Area parameters (Base Area, CSA, LSA, TSA) scale by (k^2).
   • All Volume parameters scale by (k^3).
